tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and production support. Strong techno-functional consultant driving requirements analysis, user story creation and stakeholder alignment. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with agile Scrum experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Evora Group’s reputation for pioneering digital commerce solutions. With over five years of hands-on experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and a proven record of delivering high-impact e-commerce projects.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Led the design and implementation of backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, delivering robust product, catalog and pricing services that align with enterprise architecture standards.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Architected and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring seamless synchronization across global e-commerce channels and ERP/MDM systems.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, driving rapid, reliable releases within Scrum teams.

bullets.label: Business & Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Acted as a techno-functional consultant, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and coordinating with international business and IT stakeholders to deliver value-driven solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Evora Group’s success.

tailoring.why_company: Evora Group’s commitment to innovative, end-to-end commerce platforms aligns perfectly with my passion for building scalable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions. Your focus on integrating AI-assisted delivery and omnichannel experiences resonates with the work I have driven at Rockwell Automation and Shell, where I combined technical depth with business insight to accelerate time-to-market. I am eager to bring my expertise to your Walldorf team and help shape the next generation of digital commerce.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Evora Group to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in a forward-thinking environment that values innovative, AI-driven commerce solutions and offers the chance to lead impactful projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about Evora Group’s vision and would love to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead position at Evora Group. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to your team.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application further.
